description.en: OpenAI's smaller open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning model, released under Apache 2.0 for local and lower-latency use.
description.ko: OpenAI가 Apache 2.0 라이선스로 공개한 소형 오픈 웨이트 MoE 추론 모델로, 로컬·저지연 용도를 겨냥합니다.

facts.note: Model card Table 1: 20.91B total, 3.61B active (marketed as "20b"; the Hugging Face card rounds to 21B / 3.6B).

description.en: OpenAI's larger open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning model; the model card says it fits on a single 80GB GPU.
description.ko: OpenAI의 대형 오픈 웨이트 MoE 추론 모델로, 모델 카드에 따르면 80GB GPU 한 장에 올라갑니다.

facts.note: Model card Table 1: 116.83B total, 5.13B active (marketed as "120b"; the Hugging Face card rounds to 117B / 5.1B).

description.en: xAI's first open-weight release: a 314B-parameter mixture-of-experts base model published with JAX example code under Apache 2.0.

facts.note: Mixture of 8 experts, 2 used per token; xAI does not state an active-parameter count.

description.en: Weights of the Grok 2 model that xAI trained and served in 2024; the official checkpoint is about 500 GB and is meant for 8-GPU tensor-parallel serving.

facts.note: The model README calls it the "Grok 2 Community License Agreement"; the linked LICENSE file is titled "xAI Community License Agreement".
